data.name: Festival Journey: Highland Dreams Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
The gentle rhythm of a summer in Scotland sets the stage for a journey filled with color, music, and discovery. While a light backstory brings the adventure to life, the true charm lies in the abundance of puzzles and hidden-object challenges waiting at every turn. This isn’t a tale to follow—it’s a world to explore, one delightful scene at a time.

From royal halls to hidden closes, from fireworks over the castle to songs echoing down the Royal Mile—join the Brook family as they uncover the heart of Edinburgh during its most vibrant season. For Mimi, it’s a photographer’s paradise; for Bradley, a musical adventure; for Stephanie, a sketchbook of inspiration; and for Eric, a dream come true among legends and lore. Together, they capture the spirit of the Fringe Festival—where every corner holds a story, and every moment becomes a cherished memory.

Take a break from the bustle and enjoy a varied collection of puzzles—classic hidden-object scenes, clever mini-games, and fresh challenges that test your observation and creativity. Each level offers something new to uncover and enjoy.

Featuring:

🔎 Join the Brooks on a heartfelt journey through Edinburgh’s most iconic landmarks.

🔎 Experience the magic of the Fringe Festival with music, art, theater, and delightful surprises.

🔎 Explore charming streets, hidden museums, royal palaces, and blooming gardens through diverse puzzle types.

🔎 Collect unique souvenirs, learn fascinating facts, and capture special family moments along the way.

🔎 Dozens of engaging puzzles and brain teasers to sharpen your focus.

🔎 Unlock in-game achievements as you progress through your Scottish adventure.

Let the music, color, and joy of Edinburgh’s festival season inspire you—one hidden object at a time!
